symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1473: a Change object activity mixing a reference-set Add/Remove member with other members described as `change $A (Test.A_B = $B); -- WARNING: Test.A_B (Add) stored as Add/Remove, not a set assignment; re-executing this line replaces the set — split it into `add`/`remove … $X/<Assoc>` statements`; MDL had only `=` inside CHANGE, so the activity had no faithful spelling
cause: #1288 gave Add/Remove a spelling only as the activity's SOLE member (`add … to $Obj/Assoc`); the member list inside CHANGE had one operator, so a mixed activity (or a sole Remove whose value is not a bare variable) could only be flagged, not round-tripped
file: `mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4` (changeMemberAssignment: `=` | `+=` | `-=`), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go` (memberChangeTypeOf, checkAddRemoveMember now shared with add … to), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_format_action.go` (memberChangeOperator)
insight: A WARNING in describe output is a spelling gap, not a fix: the earlier fix closed the common shape and flagged the rest, and the flagged rest became the next report. Give the operation a per-member spelling and route the single-member sugar through it, so validation (CE0033, re-measured on 11.12.4 with the guard stubbed) lives in one place. Keep the operators out of CREATE: a separate changeMemberAssignment rule makes `create … (Assoc += $X)` a parse error rather than a silent Set
